summary: Verified branded page-transition curtain fix for KNDP site. Desktop (1920x800) & mobile (390x844) tested. No visible scroll-up to hero before route change: scrollY remained at 3000 throughout 'cover' phase then dropped to 0 while curtain still covered the screen, landed on /video with scrollY=0. Curtain + KNDP logo visible mid-transition. Overlay pointer-events=none after idle, no click blocking. video-hero-cta and footer-link-video play the transition and land on correct target (contact section bounding top ~68px due to 76px offset). In-home section link (nav-link-services on '/') remained idle (no curtain) — smooth-scroll preserved. Clicking Βίντεο on /video is a no-op (phase stays idle). Rapid double-click ends idle on /video. Mobile menu closed after navigation; no horizontal overflow. Zero console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: PageTransition.go uses a ref-based busy guard — correct, prevents double-fire; verified rapid double-click behavior.

Landing.jsx schedules two scrollToId immediate calls (120ms + 330ms) behind the curtain to compensate for late layout; works but is slightly fragile — if curtain HOLD_MS/COVER change, the 330ms safety call could fire after reveal starts. Consider deriving timing from the transition constants.
scrollToId immediate branch toggles html.scrollBehavior but Lenis instance on home may still be active; current logic calls lenis.scrollTo immediate+force which is fine. OK.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend-only test. Backend untouched. Transition flows (nav, footer, CTA, mobile) all verified via Playwright. H.264 videos won't decode in headless chromium — posters only, expected.
